ops.body: 2026-10-12: the batching choice this task waited on is settled for the primary-observer design. The owner authorized fix C of the four durable cache/IO fixes (note d73db18), and it is implemented, uncommitted and unrun, in two worktrees: the producer in cc-transcript (its note a881eec and task e723e1b) and the consumer here (task d266cc9). The refuter's obligations are met by construction and pinned by regressions: the traversal is ordered and driven by the demanded predicate; a changed or corrupt child still fails a root-negative primary when a root-positive observer rides along; outcomes are reused only under the same lease generation, classifier, client, graph, lapse count and selector window. Mandatory hooks and eager evaluation of other hooks' callbacks or regexes stay out. Leave this task open until d266cc9 lands.
